review.summary: Round 4 reviews the round 3 fix, which changes only the change-set API tests and TESTING.md. A new test commits an MCP-style draft edit right after the detail's lookup and asserts that the listed operations, operationCount and the cleared validationResult all reflect it; the existing concurrent-edit test was refactored onto shared helpers with unchanged assertions. Ruff check, ruff format check and pyright pass and the change-set API module passes (35). Removing the refresh of the looked-up change set in a temporary worktree made only the new test fail, with the stale validation result, and both detail consistency tests also fail against the round 2 source; fifteen repeated runs of both tests passed. The monkeypatch targets the module-level lookup that the review detail calls, and the TESTING.md wording matches the two tests. There are no new findings.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: A new API test commits a draft edit between the detail's lookup and its single statement and asserts the refreshed validation result together with the operations and operationCount; it fails when the refresh is removed and passes with it.
